# ADDIS Logistics & Supply Chain Solutions

> Global freight forwarding, supply chain engineering, and customs clearance provider founded in 2009, operating across 150+ countries from strategic hubs in Sana'a, Aden, Hodeidah (Yemen), and Istanbul (Turkey).

## Canonical Facts
- **Legal Name**: ADDIS Logistics & Supply Chain Solutions (أديس للخدمات اللوجستية وحلول سلاسل الإمداد)
- **Founded**: 2009
- **Global Network**: +150 countries (import and export across international airports and seaports)
- **Strategic Branches**:
  - Sana'a, Yemen — Headquarters & Central Operations Hub
  - Aden, Yemen — Seaport, Free Zone & Aden International Airport Hub
  - Hodeidah, Yemen — Red Sea Maritime Terminal & Port Operations Hub
  - Istanbul, Turkey — Euro-Asian Consolidation & International Trade Hub
- **Support Availability**: 24/7 Operations & Client Desk
- **Track Record**: 1,000+ major cargo deliveries and project deployments

## Core Services
- [Air Freight](https://addislogistics-ye.com/#services): Door-to-Door service, Special Cargo, DGR (Dangerous Goods), Perishable Goods, Valuable Goods, and Air Charters.
- [Sea Freight](https://addislogistics-ye.com/#services): FCL 20ft & 40ft/HC containers, LCL consolidation, ISO Tank containers, Flexitank containers, and Ship Brokerage.
- [Road Freight](https://addislogistics-ye.com/#services): LTL & FTL fleet management, regional & cross-border corridors, transit customs, route permits, and security escorts.
- [Project Cargo](https://addislogistics-ye.com/#services): Heavy lift, Out-of-Gauge (OOG), breakbulk, air & ship charters, humanitarian NGO cargo, and specialized defense/industrial logistics.
- [Warehousing & Distribution](https://addislogistics-ye.com/#services): Bonded and general storage, inventory control, pick-and-pack, collection, and last-mile domestic distribution.
- [Customs Clearance](https://addislogistics-ye.com/#services): Full import/export brokerage, HS code classification, port/airport clearance in Yemen & Turkey, and transit documentation.
